remarks: Updated, light-filled, quintessential 1920's cottage on Shippan Point just steps to the beach! One level living w/open floor plan, beautiful architectural windows & moldings, high ceilings, hardwood floors & central air. Washer/dryer on main level. Formal living room greets you w/wood burning fireplace & built-ins. Adjacent sun room inspires w/bay window - begin or end your day w/Pilates/Peloton/yoga or simply appreciate a work from home day. Formal dining room opens directly to both the living room & kitchen, perfect for entertaining. Very spacious kitchen w/granite counters, tile backsplash, stainless steel appliances, tile flooring & recessed lighting. Breakfast room w/ceiling fan & French doors opens to expansive deck & fully fenced yard. Both bedrooms have hardwood floors & easy access to bathroom featuring new vanity w/storage, full-size tub & casement window for fresh air & light. Enjoy Shippan Point's scenic 3.5 mile loop w/stunning Long Island Sound views as an extension of your own backyard! Other amenities of this amazing water community are just a short stroll away: multiple beaches, parks, tennis, soccer, marinas, piers, clubs, neighborhood restaurants, grocery & more! And just 1-2 miles to downtown theaters, shopping & restaurants, Chelsea Piers, Harbor Point, Stamford RR & I-95. Truly the gem of Stamford just 35 miles from Manhattan! Come see why life is better by the Sound today! Access to basement for storage & lawn maintenance included. Small pet considered!
